title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?
abstract: arXiv:2611.20335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. translated_title: 决策模型何时应该比较候选对象？
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体经常需要在候选动作（如工具和网页元素）之间进行选择。决策模型应该独立地为候选对象打分，还是允许其分数依赖于其他候选对象？我们通过比较三种方法来研究这一问题：逐点打分、集合打分和候选对象注意力。在五个智能体决策基准上，逐点打分依然具有竞争力，而集合打分在某些工具选择和二元决策任务上表现更好。尽管候选对象注意力允许跨候选对象的交互，但它并未持续超越逐点打分。借助两个受控的合成任务，我们进一步考察了模型是否学会利用候选集信息。通过有针对性的关系训练，集合打分模型能够学习候选对象之间的依赖关系并泛化到分布偏移的输入，而候选对象注意力的迁移能力较弱。我们的结果表明，能够访问其他候选对象并不保证模型能有效利用候选集信息。
tldr: 该论文系统比较了逐点打分、集合打分和候选对象注意力三种候选评分方式，发现逐点打分总体仍有竞争力，集合打分在特定任务上更优且经关系训练后能学习候选间依赖并泛化，而候选对象注意力即使允许跨候选交互也未带来稳定提升。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention, showing that Pointwise remains competitive overall, Setwise performs better on certain tool-selection and binary-decision tasks and, with targeted relational training, learns candidate dependencies and generalizes, while Candidate Attention does not consistently improve despite allowing cross-candidate interaction.
